title: GTA 6 Leaks: Take-Two Subpoenas Microsoft and Discord
description: Take-Two Interactive escalates its fight against GTA 6 leaks by issuing subpoenas to Microsoft and Discord in search of leaker Cyberleek.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Leaks: Take-Two Takes Legal Action Against Microsoft and Discord

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the release of *Grand Theft Auto VI*, the battle to protect unreleased game assets and confidential information continues behind the scenes. According to a recent report by media outlet Polygon, Take-Two Interactive has taken a major step in its ongoing efforts to crack down on unauthorized disclosures by issuing subpoenas to tech giants Microsoft and Discord.

## The Hunt for "Cyberleek"

The focal point of this new legal maneuver is an individual known online as Cyberleek, who has been linked to GTA 6 leaks. Take-Two's issuance of subpoenas to both Microsoft and Discord indicates a targeted strategy to track down digital footprints, communications, or user data that could expose the true identity of the leaker. Protecting intellectual property and preventing unauthorized leaks of upcoming game details remain top priorities for major publishers, especially for a blockbuster title of this scale.

## Industry Context and Security Measures

In the modern era of game development, leaks can severely disrupt marketing strategies, undermine developer morale, and impact commercial performance. Companies like Take-Two have increasingly utilized legal avenues, working alongside major tech and communication platforms, to unmask those responsible for breaching security. While the full extent of the information requested through these subpoenas remains within the scope of the legal proceedings, the action underscores the serious consequences faced by those who leak confidential gaming material.

## Editor's Take

Take-Two's aggressive legal approach highlights just how seriously the publisher takes the security of *GTA 6*. While leaks have always been a part of the gaming ecosystem, actions involving major platforms like Microsoft and Discord send a clear warning that tracking down insiders and leakers is an active, ongoing priority for the company.
